dedupe_keys.name: nureg cr 7002 criteria for development of evacuation time estimate studies

description: NUREG/CR-7002, Criteria for Development of Evacuation Time Estimate Studies (SAND2010-0016P), is an NRC contractor report by Sandia National Laboratories and Louisiana State University, published in November 2011, that sets out guidance for developing evacuation time estimates for the plume exposure pathway emergency planning zone, an area of about 10 miles (16 km) radius around a nuclear power plant. The estimate informs protective action decision-making and traffic management plans and should give the time to evacuate 90 percent and 100 percent of the zone's population, with the 90 percent value typically used for decisions. The document covers staged evacuation protective actions, the use of approved emergency response plans and traffic control information, and the review and update of estimates, and provides a template for studies; licensees may propose alternative methods for NRC acceptance. Coverage is U.S. nuclear plant sites. Access: a 986 KB PDF on the NRC page, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: guidance text with no numerical dataset, later revised through the technical basis in NUREG/CR-7269. It suits evacuation time simulation and emergency planning studies around nuclear plants, and relates to the NRC datasets on US nuclear facilities catalogued here.
